meta.title: Hitta Lyan – track new rental apartments in Stockholm
meta.description: Get an email and a push notification the moment a new rental apartment matching your criteria is listed by the Stockholm Housing Agency (Bostadsförmedlingen).

landing.badge: Checks the Housing Agency every 30 minutes

landing.lead: Hitta Lyan keeps an eye on new listings from the Stockholm Housing Agency and sends you an email and a push notification the moment something matches your area, room count, rent – or a specific building you have your heart set on.

steps: Tap the Share button in Safari (the square with the arrow).
Open Hitta Lyan from the home screen and enable notifications here.

banner.ios: On iPhone you get notifications if you add Hitta Lyan to your home screen: Share → Add to Home Screen, open it from there and enable under Account.
banner.iosInstalled: Enable notifications under Account and we will get in touch the moment something matches.
banner.android: Enable notifications under Account to get a notification on your phone when something matches.

guide.installed: Hitta Lyan is installed on your home screen. Tap the button above to enable notifications.

ios.title: iPhone and iPad
steps: Open Hitta Lyan in Safari and tap the Share button (the square with the arrow).
Open Hitta Lyan from the home screen, go to Account and tap “Enable notifications”.
ios.note: Requires iOS 16.4 or later. Notifications only work in the home-screen version, not in regular Safari. Not getting notifications? Settings → Notifications → Hitta Lyan.

android.title: Android
steps: Open Hitta Lyan in Chrome, Edge, Samsung Internet or Firefox.
Go to Account and tap “Enable notifications”, allow when the phone asks.
Optional: add to the home screen via the browser menu for quicker access.
android.note: Not getting notifications? Check Settings → Apps → your browser → Notifications, and that battery saver is not restricting the browser.

desktop.title: Desktop
steps: Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari (macOS 13 or later) are supported.
Go to Account and click “Enable notifications”, allow in the browser prompt.
Notifications also appear when the tab is closed, as long as the browser is running.
desktop.note: On Mac: System Settings → Notifications → your browser must be allowed. On Windows: Settings → System → Notifications.
